text:
Aiden: Heads-up — Prospect Solaris asked for a 1-week POC to validate a customer model 'Solaris-28B-pro' with two runtime variants (fp16, 4-bit). They want Dedicated + VPC peering and per-token reporting. Can SE/infra/sec triage?

Priya: Need repo and license. Tokenizer type? Will they push to our blob or give S3 pull creds?

Aiden: Repo: https://git.example/solaris/solar-pro tag release-2026-03-12. Tokenizer: sentencepiece with custom normalizer. Checkpoint: pytorch .bin + tokenizer.model. They said "commercial ok" in intake but license file ambiguous.

Sam: Quick probe plan: clone, run tokenizer sanity, run a lightweight forward through our runtime shim. Commands: 
```
git clone https://git.example/solaris/solar-pro /tmp/solar
python tools/check_spm_normalizer.py --model /tmp/solar --sample "Test prompt"
python tools/run_shim.py --model /tmp/solar --dtype fp16 --seq 256 --batch 1
```

ops-bot: ticket IN-99421 created: "Solaris-28B presales compatibility" assigned to @sam, watchers: @priya, @theo, @aiden.

Sam: Tokenizer loads but uses a custom normalization step (unicode folds + zwnj rules). I mapped it to our normalizer in a small shim. Forward failed at KV cache ordering: got (seq, heads, head_dim) vs runtime expect (heads, seq, head_dim). I'll open a tiny adapter to reshape and add a tokenizer mapping layer.

Theo: For Dedicated sizing: FP16 path -> 2xA100-80GB recommended for stable throughput; 4-bit could drop to 1xA100 with sharding but must validate quality. POC infra estimate ~4.1k USD for 7 days at low token volume. SE support + quant pipeline add ~12h of engineering.

Priya: Security/legal: I checked LICENSE.md — it has a clause "non-redistribution without consent". I'm asking Solaris legal for a hosting waiver or commercial license for the POC. If they refuse, we can offer an on-prem run with our engineers under an MSA addendum. Also requested SOC2 + CIDR for peering.

Aiden: Action items: Sam -> runtime adapter PR + validated fp16 smoke run; Theo -> provision provisional Dedicated pool + cost calc; Priya -> SQA draft + license follow-up; I'll coordinate customer comms. Target EOD update tomorrow.

Sam: PR opened: internal/pr/5230 — adapter reshapes KV cache and hooks normalizer mapping. FP16 smoke tests passed on short eval set. Next: run full eval and attempt 4-bit conversion in staging.

Theo: Preview pool created: d-poc-solaris-42 (preview). ETA for readiness ~3h. Posted cost breakdown in ticket.

Priya: SQA checklist uploaded and license query sent to Solaris legal. Marked licensing as potential blocker until we get a hosting waiver.

Aiden: If Solaris provides a hosting license waiver we proceed with quantization and full POC. If not, propose on-prem POC. Check-in 10:00 PT tomorrow. :calendar:
